```{r hrd_external_prep}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

hrd_ext <- pcgrr::hrd_external_display(pcg_report$content$hrd)

cat("The HRD status below was determined by an external HRD assay/tool (__",
    hrd_ext$caller, "__), and provided as input to PCGR. Type of score: __",
    hrd_ext$score_type_label, "__.\n\n", sep = "")

hrd_status_theme <- "dark"
if (hrd_ext$status == "Indeterminate") {
  hrd_status_theme <-
    bslib::value_box_theme(bg = pcgrr::color_palette$warning, fg = "#000000")
}
```

```{r hrd_external_boxes}
#| echo: false

bslib::layout_columns(
  col_widths = c(4, 4, 4),
  height = "110px",
  bslib::value_box(
    title = "HRD status",
    value = hrd_ext$status,
    showcase = NULL,
    theme = hrd_status_theme
  ),
  bslib::value_box(
    title = hrd_ext$score_title,
    value = hrd_ext$score_value,
    showcase = NULL,
    theme = "dark"
  ),
  bslib::value_box(
    title = "HRD assay/tool",
    value = hrd_ext$caller,
    showcase = NULL,
    theme = "dark"
  )
)
```

```{r hrd_external_components}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr length(hrd_ext$components) > 0

## genomic scar components (if given), in a toned-down style
component_theme <- bslib::value_box_theme(bg = "#ced4da", fg = "#212529")
do.call(
  bslib::layout_columns,
  c(list(col_widths = rep(4, length(hrd_ext$components)), height = "90px"),
    lapply(names(hrd_ext$components), function(nm) {
      bslib::value_box(
        title = nm, value = hrd_ext$components[[nm]],
        showcase = NULL, theme = component_theme)
    })))
```

```{r hrd_external_notes}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

cat("\n\n", hrd_ext$basis_note, "\n\n", sep = "")

if (!is.na(hrd_ext$internal_note)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\n**PCGR genomic scar score**\n\n",
      hrd_ext$internal_note, " See the tab \"", hrd_tab_int, "\" for details.",
      "\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
}
cat("<br>\n\n")
```
